Grain Storage & Handling Site, Trangie, NSW 2823

Full Time General Clerk
$98,000 per annum plus superannuation

Summary
The General Clerk provides administrative and clerical support to the operations of Dubbo
Grain Packing (DGP). The position is responsible for maintaining records, processing
documentation, data entry, preparing correspondence, coordinating office activities, and
supporting grain storage and handling operations through efficient administrative services.

Duties and Responsibilities

General Administrative Support
•	Perform a range of clerical and administrative duties to support site operations.
•	Prepare, process and file business documents, forms and correspondence.
•	Maintain electronic and physical filing systems.
•	Receive, sort and distribute incoming mail and communications.
•	Assist management with routine administrative tasks.

Record Keeping and Data Entry
•	Enter and update operational information into company databases and record systems.
•	Maintain records relating to grain receivals, dispatches and inventory movements.
•	Verify information for accuracy and completeness.
•	Retrieve records and documents as requested by management.
•	Ensure records are maintained in accordance with company procedures.

Document Preparation
•	Prepare routine reports, spreadsheets, forms and correspondence.
•	Compile operational data for management reporting purposes.
•	Assist with preparation of meeting agendas, minutes and administrative documentation.
•	Maintain document registers and administrative records.

Customer and Stakeholder Liaison
•	Respond to routine enquiries from customers, suppliers, transport operators and
•	contractors.
•	Direct enquiries to appropriate personnel when required.
•	Provide administrative support to visitors and site personnel.
•	Maintain professional communication with internal and external stakeholders.

Operational Administration Support
•	Assist with processing grain receival and dispatch documentation.
•	Maintain weighbridge and transport records.
•	Support scheduling and coordination of administrative activities during harvest periods.
•	Assist operational staff with document management and record maintenance.

Compliance Administration
•	Maintain records required for workplace health and safety, training and compliance
•	purposes.
•	Assist with preparation of documentation for audits and inspections.
•	Ensure administrative records are current, accurate and readily accessible.
•	Support implementation of company policies and procedures.

Reporting
•	Prepare routine administrative and operational reports.
•	Compile statistical information and summaries as requested by management.
•	Assist with monitoring and reporting of administrative activities.

Skills and Competencies
•	Strong administrative and clerical skills.
•	Accurate data entry and record management capability.
•	Sound computer and office software skills.
•	Strong organisational and time management skills.
•	Effective written and verbal communication skills.
•	Attention to detail and accuracy.

Qualifications and Experience
•	Certificate III, Certificate IV or higher qualification in Business Administration or a related field; or
•	At least one year of relevant clerical or administrative experience.
•	At least 12 months experience with a program called Agtech and Agri-digital.

result.description: A & M Packaging Pty Ltd  A & M Packaging Pty Limited is a leading Australian provider of flexible packaging solutions, committed to quality, innovation, and operational excellence. We provide comprehensive services ranging from packaging design and lamination to conversion and distribution. We are currently seeking a highly skilled Quality Engineering Officer to join our team and drive technical optimization across our manufacturing operations.  The Quality Engineering Officer will play a critical role in optimizing our packaging production lines and manufacturing technologies. You will be responsible for analysing system performance, implementing process improvements, and ensuring that our manufacturing workflows operate at peak efficiency, quality, and compliance. This role bridges the gap between production and engineering, requiring a hands-on approach to technical troubleshooting, equipment validation, and data-driven continuous improvement.   Benefits   Task & responsibilities   Evaluate manufacturing lines and equipment performance to pinpoint opportunities for increasing productivity, efficiency, and product quality.  Conduct root cause analysis on equipment failures and process anomalies, implementing engineering-based solutions to restore and enhance operational reliability.  Formulate and execute process improvement strategies aimed at maximizing resource utilization and reducing operational waste.  Assess production methods against established technical specifications and engineering standards to ensure all manufacturing processes remain within defined parameters.  Provide hands-on technical guidance and troubleshooting for production machinery and process technologies to mitigate downtime and boost system output.  Design, refine, and enforce technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and process controls to maintain consistency in production outcomes.  Partner with production, quality, and engineering teams to streamline packaging systems and refine manufacturing workflows.  Participate in the commissioning, testing, and validation of new manufacturing assets to ensure they meet performance and engineering benchmarks.  Develop and oversee testing and inspection protocols to verify process capability and maintain rigorous product performance standards.  Analyse production metrics and performance data to identify operational trends, supporting the implementation of continuous improvement projects.  Assist in the maintenance of operational and quality management frameworks to ensure alignment with industry regulations and internal business requirements.  Track the success of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), evaluating the impact of implemented solutions and recommending further technical upgrades where needed.    Qualification & experience   A tertiary qualification (Bachelor’s degree or Higher) in Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related technical discipline.  Proven professional experience in a manufacturing, packaging, or industrial processing environment.  At least 3 years of professional experience in a similar role.  Solid understanding of engineering principles, production workflows, and manufacturing process controls.  Proficiency in utilising ERP systems (e.g., SAP or Microsoft Dynamics 365) for production data analysis and operational monitoring.  Demonstrated ability to conduct root cause analysis, troubleshoot equipment issues, and implement effective engineering solutions.  Excellent communication skills, with the ability to provide technical guidance and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.   About Company    A & M Packaging Pty Limited is a leading Australian manufacturer and supplier of flexible packaging solutions, specializing in high-performance lamination, conversion, and distribution services across the country. We partner with a diverse range of industries to deliver consistently high standards of manufacturing quality, technical precision, and operational efficiency.  With a strong commitment to engineering excellence and service, we provide tailored packaging solutions designed to meet the complex technical requirements of each client. Our business places significant emphasis on process innovation, workplace safety, and continuous improvement to ensure our production systems are highly efficient, reliable, and performance-driven.  At A & M Packaging, our team members are dedicated professionals who take pride in their technical expertise and contribute directly to the innovation and operational success of our manufacturing operations. result.description:
At Riot, we believe in putting players first. Our Sydney-based team is partnering globally to build next-generation features and technology on an exciting Unpublished R&D Title. The team focuses on supporting the game's visual targets and content production needs - helping our artists to realize a vibrant and rich world for players to be immersed and express themselves in.

As a Senior Technical Artist, Tools & Pipeline, you’ll shape the creative engine that powers our teams - defining and elevating end-to-end workflows across disciplines including Character Art, Animation, Environment Art, Audio, and VFX. You’ll be a strategic partner to artists, Technical Art, and Engineering, evaluating tools and pipelines, clarifying production requirements, and ensuring our workflows enable creativity at scale. Your work will directly impact how ideas move from concept to shipped content, empowering multiple teams to operate efficiently in parallel production streams.

In this role, you’ll help stand up and sustain scalable tools and processes, providing hands-on technical support while gathering data and feedback to continuously improve the artist experience. You’ll build strong cross-disciplinary relationships to uncover pain points and guide meaningful system and pipeline improvements. As an active member of Riot’s Technical Art community, you’ll mentor fellow TAs, contribute to craft growth, and foster a culture of knowledge sharing through clear documentation and open feedback. By setting clear goals, offering actionable direction, and championing continuous improvement, you’ll ensure our workflows not only support today’s production but evolve to meet the ambitions of tomorrow.

You will report to the Manager, Technical Art, and work closely with the Technical Art Director and other members of the team abroad.

Responsibilities:
Define and level up the end-to-end workflow for our many creative disciplines, such as Character Art, Animation, Environment Art, Audio, and VFX
Collaborate with Technical Art and Engineering partners to support artist needs, including evaluating tools and workflows, and communicating requirements for production.
Help stand up and maintain scalable artist tools and workflows to support multiple teams in parallel production streams.
Provide technical support to artists working from our art workflows, collecting data to further improve the tools they are using, making recommendations and improvements where necessary
Be an active member of the Tech Art community within Riot, participate in craft-focused meetings and events, and actively mentor for other Technical Artists in their craft
Build close relationships with artists and engineers to understand needs, identify pain points, and help guide workflow, pipeline, and system improvements.
Spread knowledge of the team’s processes through documentation and help teams expand their technical know-how
Consistently give and take constructive feedback, direct next steps, and communicate clear goals and outcomes to your team

Required Qualifications: 
6+ years of professional experience as a technical artist in games or related industries.
Professional experience in content creation and tool development for DCC tools, such as Autodesk Maya, 3DS Max, Adobe Suite, ZBrush, Houdini, Substance Suite, or Blender.
Professional experience working in Unreal Engine 5.
Highly proficient in Python tool development, with a particular focus on building scalable, maintainable, and high-performance tools for a variety of artist use-cases.
Professional experience with modern UI frameworks such as PySide & PyQt.
Strong understanding of art workflows and the ability to translate artistic needs into technical requirements.
Highly proficient communication skills and capacity to act as an ambassador between art and engineering.
Superb critical thinking skills, particularly as it pertains to translating artistic requirements to sustainable workflow design.
Proactive, responsible, and comfortable owning ambiguous or evolving problem spaces.

Desired Qualifications:
Experience with C++ and UMG for Unreal Engine 5.
Excellent UI/UX design and front-end development (especially Qt/PyQt).
Strong understanding of performance considerations for modern hardware and optimization techniques required for delivering a scalable, high performance product.
Experience working on a large-scale, AAA game with a sizable, cross-disciplinary team.
Experience with character rigging and animation pipelines.

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     ASO3 PAS Data Integrity Officer - PAS





Job no: 941831

Work type: Full time

Located in: Adelaide Metro Northern

Categories: Administration, Business and Management




 

Northern Adelaide Local Health Network - Corporate Services - Elizabeth South

Salary: $74,095 - $78,694 per annum - plus Superannuation and Salary Sacrifice Benefits - ASO3

Ongoing Full-Time

About the Role:

As a PAS (Patient Administrative System) Data Integrity Officer, you will play a critical role in maintaining the accuracy, quality and integrity of patient information within the Sunrise Electronic Medical Record (EMR) across the Northern Adelaide Local Health Network. Working within the Patient Administrative System Data Integrity Unit (PAS DIU), you will help ensure patient registration, demographic and activity data meets State and Federal data standards, supporting safe patient care, accurate reporting and organisational performance.

Working closely with Health Information Management Services, clinical teams, administrative staff, the Registry Integrity Unit and other stakeholders, you will provide expert advice on patient registration practices, investigate and resolve data discrepancies, monitor key performance indicators, and contribute to ongoing quality improvement initiatives. You will also support staff education and provide guidance on data standards, procedures and best practice to strengthen data quality across the network.

The PAS DIU provides leadership in the management, education and administration of PAS in Sunrise EMR, with expertise in SA Health data management, patient registration, data quality and integrity, health information management, and patient activity data capture associated with Casemix and Activity Based Funding (ABF). In this role, you will contribute to these functions through the management of duplicate registrations, data validation, auditing, reporting, troubleshooting data quality issues and supporting compliance with Admitted Patient Care (APC) requirements and Consumer Identification Standards.

About You:

You are a highly organised and detail-focused professional with a passion for data accuracy and quality. You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, the ability to manage competing priorities, and a commitment to maintaining confidentiality when working with sensitive information.

With excellent communication skills and a collaborative approach, you build effective relationships with a wide range of stakeholders while providing expert support to improve patient registration practices, data quality and compliance across the health service.

This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented professional who enjoys analysing information, solving complex problems and making a meaningful contribution to the quality, accuracy and reliability of health information that underpins patient care, service planning and funding outcomes.

About Us:

The Northern Adelaide Local Health Network (NALHN) is a leading provider of public healthcare services in South Australia, and one of the largest employers in northern Adelaide. 

NALHN serves over 400,000 people in northern Adelaide with a comprehensive range of high-quality healthcare services, including emergency, surgical, obstetric, neonatal, paediatric, oncology, geriatric, palliative care and rehabilitation, and mental health care, as well as primary health care services with a focus on community health promotion and chronic disease management.

With a commitment for ongoing upgrades to our facilities and the introduction of new services, our priority is delivering exceptional health and wellbeing services that enhance the quality of life for our community.

With over 7,000 employees, NALHN emphasises quality care and a supportive work environment guided by respect, integrity, and accountability. Our core values foster excellence, innovation, and equitable health outcomes. 

At NALHN Everyone Has a Story, Everyone Matters, Everyone Contributes and Everyone Grows. 

Our Local Health Network Sites and Services:

NALHN provides a range of hospital (inpatient), outpatient, community and home-based services across multiple sites in Adelaide's north and north-eastern suburbs, including Aboriginal health, mental health, and GP services.

Lyell McEwin Hospital - the major hospital in northern Adelaide for emergency care, complex and multi-day surgery, medicine, obstetric, paediatrics and outpatient services.

Modbury Hospital - a general hospital with emergency care, elective surgery, medicine, outpatient and sub-acute services, rehabilitation, geriatric and palliative care.

Mental Health Services - adult and older persons mental health services and statewide forensic mental health services, across hospital and community settings.

Watto Purrunna Aboriginal Primary Health Care Services - provides culturally responsive primary healthcare services for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people in-hospital and across four community sites.

Primary Health Care Services - including GP Plus sites at Elizabeth, Modbury and Gilles Plains.

Benefits of working at NALHN:

From salary packaging to flexible working arrangements, a large range of opportunities for movement and career progression, you'll find there are lots of benefits of working with Northern Adelaide Local Health Network.

Salary packaging is an option for saving money by paying for some of your everyday expenses from your salary before it is taxed.

Relocation assistance may be available for successful applicants from interstate or overseas.

NALHN supports and fosters a culture in which employees feel they belong and feel safe at work. The culture aims to encourage all people to use their talents and to be valued and rewarded for their contributions.

SA Health is committed to providing an inclusive workplace that embraces diversity and inclusion for all employees. We strongly encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent, culturally diverse backgrounds, members of the LGBTIQA+SB community and people who live with disability and-or neurodivergence.

We are committed to making workplace adjustments to provide a positive and supportive work environment. You are encouraged to let us know if you have any support or access requirements during the recruitment process and beyond to ensure you can perform at your best.

The South Australian public sector promotes diversity and flexible ways of working including part-time. Applicants are encouraged to discuss the flexible working arrangements for this role.

Appointment will be subject to a satisfactory Criminal History Check.

Trading under Publicis Communications Australia
Role: Technical Lead
Location: Sydney

Who we are

Consumer habits are anything but linear, and attention must be earned. At Digitas, we understand that, to break through, brands must be surprising, entertaining and authentic. 

Driven by imagination and fueled by deep cultural, consumer and business insights, we craft impactful creative experiences across every medium — from integrated campaigns, gaming, and physical experiences to full-length feature films. 

We earn the right for brands to be part of their customers’ networks. We drive growth with our amazing clients, through our capabilities in Consulting, Products & Platforms, Customer Engagement and Digital Media.

Part of Publicis Groupe, and a Leader in Gartner’s Magic Quadrant for Global Marketing Agencies, we’re proud to work with some of the world’s leading brands.

Digitas – The Networked Experience Agency


The role:

The purpose of this role is to lead the technical design and delivery of impactful customer engagement solutions using the Braze platform, focused on a single, high-profile client with room to grow across the agency. As the Technical Lead, you will translate creative ideas into actionable Braze and data solutions, ensuring seamless execution. You will collaborate with stakeholders, develop prototypes, mentor technical teams, and maintain high standards for performance, documentation, and innovation.

This role focuses on 2 core areas:
1.	Technical leadership and solution design 
2.	Stakeholder collaboration and team development

 
Day to day you’ll get:

•	Work cross-functionally with the client and our account, creative, strategy and analytics teams to translate creative ideas into technical and data requirements for the Braze platform. Your vision will ensure client success from idea to implementation. 
•	Scope/build rapid prototypes which help us to respond to client briefs and assess technical viability.
•	Be the main point of contact when it comes to data requirements for Braze. Liaise with internal and external teams to ensure that we are leveraging client data securely, effectively and efficiently.
Ensure that all solutions are endorsed and supported by our client’s global and local technology teams and that all established standards are adhered to.
•	Be the absolute subject matter expert for our internal team and clients when it comes to the Braze platform 
•	Advise and mentor a local/offshore technical delivery team, fostering growth, capability and process.  
•	Work with the Digitas tech team to troubleshoot, test, and optimize solutions to achieve maximum performance with minimal errors.
Ensure continuity for the account by establishing and maintaining standards across the tech team for documentation and knowledge exchange.

Skills:
•	Expert level on-tool skills with one of the major customer engagement platforms (Salesforce, Adobe, Braze) 
•	Candidates with Braze experience are preferred. 
•	Salesforce, Braze or other certifications are a plus but not required
•	Ability to quickly learn new systems and processes.
•	Strong working knowledge of modern marketing data tools and integration patterns with an emphasis on how to solution data for targeting, personalisation and reporting 
•	Working knowledge of CDPs such as Segment, Tealium and mParticle. mParticle experience is a huge plus 
•	Analytical thinking, asking the right questions and challenging for better outcomes  
•	Strategic thinker, pushing the boundaries and always challenging us to think bigger or differently
•	Excellent collaboration, written and verbal communication skills

The person we are looking for has:

•	7+ years of experience working on the technical side of Martech, marketing automation or customer engagement roles
•	Background in prototyping and light coding. Minimally you should be strong in basic web languages (HTML, CSS, JS) and scripting languages such as Liquid or ActionScript. 
•	2+ years of experience articulating solution designs with Martech platforms
•	Proven track record of successful solution design work 
•	Experience working with complex data environments which depend on streaming data 
•	Experience managing and mentoring technical delivery teams
•	Bonus points for prior agency/consultancy experience, as well as working with/leading off-shore delivery teams

Got what it takes? We’d love to hear from you.

Our offer to you:

Be a part of the Publicis Groupe family, one of the world’s most progressive and dynamic modern communications businesses enjoying all the perks that come with our network offering:
•	Work with a diverse team where we value all the benefits of harnessing differences for our people, our clients and our business.
•	A committed Diversity Inclusion and Belonging strategy are driven through our Viva! Women, Tahi Katoa, Wholeself and Égalité programs
•	A creative, fun and rewarding office environment backed up by our Publicis Liberté flexibility approach
•	Access to employee benefits including – wellness programmes, learning and development opportunities, and network events
•	Day off on your birthday.

If you don’t tick every box in this ad, please don’t rule yourself out.  We focus on hiring people who share our values of inclusion, collaboration, adaptability, fearlessness, and integrity, rather than ticking boxes – so if this role resonates with you, please apply.

Diversity. Inclusion. Equity. More than just words, these are part of our DNA. 

At Publicis Groupe we are committed to the inclusion and recognition of all people; regardless of race, age, culture, ability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status and religious affiliation. We believe that to deliver the best solutions to our clients, our people need to reflect the diverse communities in which our clients operate in. We value diversity and the skills, knowledge and experience that difference brings to our culture and solutions. 

Uniqueness is powerful; without it we wouldn’t be where we are today. So be you – we like it that way. 

We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments for people with disability or those that require additional support throughout the application process.  

Salary: Over threshold

Contact: Loretta Wood - Manager, Workforce Systems - loretta.wood@mercy.com.au

Where there's life, there's Mercy.

Where there's care, there's You.

Through the battles and the breakthroughs, we're there. Where will you be?

For over a century, our incredible teams have provided care for people at every stage of life. Across our aged care homes, hospitals and research facilities, and across numerous cities and towns, we're on a journey to keep growing our impact for the next hundred years.

As a for-purpose organisation with over 10,000 dedicated, compassionate people, we continue to offer more services and deeper care than ever before. With Mercy, you'll have the chance to make an impact and gain experience that's hard to find elsewhere.

At Mercy Health, it's all about taking what we have and making it better.

To do that, we need you.

Join us at Mercy Health, and help our teams deliver even greater outcomes.

About the opportunity

Mercy Health, you'll become part of a proud history built on over 100 years of expertise, skill and care. As the Workforce Systems and Data Officer, you'll use your expertise in workforce systems, data integrity, award interpretation, and system optimisation to support accurate workforce processes, drive continuous improvement, and help ensure employees are paid correctly and on time.

Manage and optimise workforce systems and employee data.

Configure rostering, time & attendance, and award interpretation rules.

Support system integrations, upgrades, testing, and enhancements.

Investigate and resolve workforce system and payroll issues.

Perform data reconciliations and maintain data integrity.

Collaborate with Payroll, HR, IT, and vendors to drive continuous improvement.

What you'll bring

It takes a special kind of person to work in healthcare or community services. If you are genuinely interested in helping others, then you'll find you can build something here and find your place in a team of 10,000 hearts.

To thrive in this role, you will have:

result.description: Savic Motorcycles Limited   About the Role   We are seeking a Mechanical Engineer to design, develop, validate and improve the mechanical systems, components and manufacturing processes of the Savic C-Series electric motorcycle platform. This is an engineering role covering the full product lifecycle, from concept design through to production readiness, with genuine ownership of components and systems on a market-leading Australian-designed electric motorcycle.   Key Responsibilities    Design, develop and optimise mechanical components, assemblies and vehicle systems for the Savic C-Series platform and upcoming models, including chassis, suspension, bodywork, mounting systems and structural components.  Translate performance, durability, safety and manufacturing requirements into engineering specifications, drawings, tolerances and technical documentation.  Develop manufacturing-ready designs using Design for Manufacture and Assembly principles, GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis and material selection.  Perform and support engineering analysis including finite element analysis, fatigue analysis and topology optimisation, and develop and execute mechanical test plans and validation procedures.  Support the transition of designs from prototype to repeatable, production-ready manufacture, including release of manufacturing drawings, work instructions and inspection requirements.  Design or support the development of jigs, fixtures, gauges and other production aids to improve quality, safety and repeatability.  Maintain Engineering Change Management records, Bills of Materials, drawing releases and New Product Introduction documentation, including DFMEA, PFMEA and PPAP activities.  Lead FRACAS Meetings focusing on analysis, quality assurance and continuous improvement functions of mechanical components, in alignment with the software, systems and electrical engineering teams.    Support structured root-cause analysis and corrective action processes and maintain fault and corrective action records in Notion or other nominated engineering systems.  Identify opportunities to improve cost, manufacturability, weight and performance of components and assemblies, and evaluate alternative materials and manufacturing methods.  Work closely with Electrical, Software, Systems, Manufacturing, Quality and Aftersales teams to ensure mechanical systems integrate effectively with the wider vehicle platform.    What We're Looking For    Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.  Demonstrated experience designing, developing and validating mechanical components, assemblies or systems in an automotive, motorcycle, EV, manufacturing, aerospace, robotics or related product-development environment.  Strong capability in mechanical design for manufacture, including GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis, materials selection, manufacturing drawings and production documentation.  Experience with engineering analysis and validation methods, including FEA, fatigue assessment, physical testing, data acquisition or structured test planning.  Experience applying engineering quality and risk-management methods such as DFMEA, PFMEA, 8D, 5D, DMAIC, DFSS, PPAP or equivalent.  Experience supporting engineering change management, BOM control, drawing release and New Product Introduction processes.  Strong practical understanding of manufacturing processes, tooling, jigs, fixtures, machining, casting, fabrication or assembly methods.  Proficient with CAD, PLM/PDM, project management, engineering documentation and issue-tracking systems; experience with Notion, Jira, Odoo or equivalent systems is highly regarded.    Our Brand   In this role, you will act in accordance with our brand values and help us deliver our brand vision: to make EV riding enjoyable to every rider in the world.   We put people first — our customers are at the heart of what we do.  We design in Australia — being an Aussie brand is in our DNA.  We make informed decisions — using data, insights and experience.  We actually care — each person is personally passionate about what we're doing.      About Company      Savic Motorcycles is redefining the electric motorcycle industry with premium, high-performance machines that blend cutting-edge technology, sleek design and an exclusive brand experience. Our Engineering team is responsible for ensuring Savic motorcycles are safe, reliable, manufacturable, commercially viable, and continuously improving as the business scales.
